rubric_additions.rubric-22:
Rule: Audit: plan source-supported ownership and tests that can detect incorrect behavior.
Example: With logs set to otlp and traces set to console, an SDK span dump must not become an application LogRecord.
Evidence: Plan a compatibility decision for each selected SDK console writer on logs, traces and metrics, even when no global console bridge is proposed. Use a proven compatible application producer, or record the added console-to-OTLP route as Not configured/unsupported. Preserve operator SDK exporters and native output. Plan checks that SDK console output is not captured as application LogRecords, including selected deferred-Resource resolution or direct-SDK emission paths. Include a normal-profile control showing that the supported application bridge still emits its expected record. Do not add a second or incompatible bridge or remove an operator exporter to hide extra records.
Insufficient evidence: Guarding only the logs selector; treating an omitted bridge as working application logging; processor construction alone; dropping an operator console exporter; or testing only an immediate console write when deferred Resource output is selected.
